entries.test: Public reports of ChatGPT producing garbled output around 20–21 February 2024, and whether OpenAI had explained the cause when the post was published.
entries.note: The question is rhetorical, but he asserts this premise. OpenAI explained the bug soon after (an inference/token-selection error), so 'unexplained' was true only when he wrote it.

entries.test: Documented Gemini outputs from around February 2024 that got the Apollo 11 crew wrong.
entries.note: The wording is somewhat exaggerated, but it refers to a specific reported failure that can be checked.

entries.test: Whether any formal (mathematical) guarantees of correctness or reliability existed for systems like Sora, ChatGPT or Gemini as of February 2024.
entries.note: 'Work' is vague, but the plain reading is formal verification guarantees.

entries.test: Marcus's public writings since LLMs first appeared (for example his 2019–2020 critiques of GPT-2 and GPT-3), checked for whether he called them overhyped from the start.
entries.note: He writes about himself in the third person, probably as a sign-off line. 'From day 1' is loose.
